title: Introduce compact premerge validator and clean up release annotation flow
author: Marco Rivera
release_notes: Adds a lightweight premerge validator to reduce CI latency for small changes; tightens release annotation logic so release tooling no longer relies on brittle adhoc tags. No API changes.
description: Context: Running full lint + integration matrices on every small change has been slowing down developer feedback and contributing to noisy release annotations. This PR introduces a compact premerge validator that runs a reduced lint subset and fast static checks for small PRs, plus a refactor of the release annotation generator to remove implicit tag parsing and replace it with explicit annotations emitted at merge time. Motivation: faster premerge feedback for high-velocity contributors, fewer false-positive release notes, and easier reasoning about automated release rollouts. What I changed: - New CI action 'ci/actions/compact-premerge.yml' that runs path-aware quick-lint checks, lightweight unit smoke, and a small file-change size gate. - Extracted lint telemetry into 'tools/lint/telemetry.py' with a sampling mode to reduce datastore load. - New release annotator service in 'scripts/release/annotator.go' which consumes merge metadata and Linear links instead of parsing commit messages. - Small dev experience helpers: 'tools/lint/run_local.sh' for fast local validation and updated devcontainer to preinstall quick-tooling. - Updated docs/CONTRIBUTING.md with a section on premerge expectation and how to opt out of compact mode. Checklist: - [x] Implementation compiles and unit tests pass locally - [x] CI green after two reruns (flaky lint shard) - [x] Docs updated - [x] Linear stories linked (ENG-1247, ENG-1302) Rollout plan: Merge to main behind feature flag (env CI_COMPACT_PREMERGE=true). Monitor premerge failure rate and telemetry for 72 hours; if false positives > 3% revert flag. Backwards compatibility: release annotator introduces a new annotation key 'release.scope' but falls back to existing behavior when absent; migration script included to backfill recent merges. Related: follows-up on prior infra work for path-aware CI (ENG-1102) and release stability hardening (ENG-1189).

motivation_and_context: High-level goal: reduce time-to-first-feedback and reduce noise in release notes. Compact premerge is conservative by default and targets PRs under 20 changed files; larger PRs still go through the full matrix. Release annotator removes error-prone commit parsing and centralizes annotation semantics so downstream release automation can be simplified.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Enable CI_COMPACT_PREMERGE=true in dev lane for 72h monitoring (scheduled). 2) Run scripts/release/migrate_backfill.sh to backfill annotations for merges from last 7 days. 3) Monitor telemetry dashboard: premerge-false-positive, premerge-latency, release-annotation-failures. 4) Small follow-up: add feature flag to rollout annotator on enterprise clusters (ENG-1302).
notes_for_changelog: improvement: compact premerge validator for faster feedback; chore: release annotator refactor to structured annotations; docs: CONTRIBUTING updated.
ci_flaky_notes: Observed one intermittent formatter-related lint failure on initial CI run; fixed by pinning the formatter version in package.json. Lint telemetry sampling prevents spikes in metrics collection and reduces cost.
size_guidance: Compact premerge is opt-in per-repo via CODEOWNERS pattern and opt-out via PR label 'full-ci'. By default applies to PRs with changed_files_count < 20 and additions < 1000.
testing_notes: Added tests/premerge/quick_smoke_test.py for the compact lane; added unit tests for annotator edge-cases. Local dev flow validated via tools/lint/run_local.sh which emulates compact checks.
additional_context: This PR is intentionally conservative: it does not remove any existing full-matrix gating and provides explicit opt-out. Expect a follow-up to wire compact telemetry into the main CI dashboard and to add an admin control to tune sampling rates.
